newsitem.title: UK: Natural Stone Holdings to seek admission to AIM. [corrected 13:10 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Natural Stone Holdings to seek admission to AIM. [corrected 13:10 gmt]

text.p: Natural Stone Holdings Limited said on Tuesday it plans to list on London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via an offer of shares raising up to 6.0 million stg.

The issue is expected to value the company at 33.5 million stg, a company spokesman said. Dealings are expected to commence on February 24. (Corrects from "between 34.0 and 40.0 million" to "33.5 million".)
Natural Stone said it had in Richtersveld, South Africa the largest-known deposit of Bowenite, a semi precious jade.
"Natural Stone has a unique resource in its reserves of Bowenite," said chief executive Patrick von Stauffenberg.

"The size of these reserves opens up for the first time the opportunity for jade to become a prestige decorative stone in the building and architectural markets. Our flotation on AIM will assist in exploiting this exciting market opportunity."
On flotation, Natural Stone will complete a recommended offer for Germany's Naturstein Beteiligungs AG, which will administer its operations in South Africa.
The broker to the issue is IA Pritchard and the nominated adviser is Grant Thornton.
